objective: Implement exact provenance-rich BSD arithmetic schemas and supplied-data generic/Jacobian analytic quotient assembly with deterministic serialization

oracles: Exact hand-computed rank 0-3 quotient fixtures and basis-change identities

handoff.summary: Implemented a portable dual-aware BSD arithmetic schema and atomic supplied-data quotient for generic abelian varieties and principally polarized hyperelliptic Jacobians. The module preserves exact rational factors, explicit provenance and rank/period/regulator/Tamagawa/torsion/subgroup states, L^(r)(1)/r! normalization, total-Omega and Neron-basis metadata, recomputed determinant and positivity checks, complete bad-prime coverage, typed object/basis/regulator/index-bound subgroup certificates, a diagnostics-derived LFunctionInit adapter, deterministic tamper-checked JSON, and flat SQLite records with reproducible object digests. Generic finite-index ambiguity is excluded by requiring separate full A/Adual bases. Focused CPython and Sage.js fixtures cover ranks 0--3, basis changes, generic A/Adual torsion, incomplete or extraneous Tamagawa data, certificate transplantation and tampering, strict schema decoding, object identity, index promotion, rigor propagation, and serialization.
risks: Decimal and interval transport is exact at input but rounded arithmetic is deliberately non-rigorous because it does not implement directed outward rounding.

The LFunctionInit public surface does not expose independent coarse/refined leading derivatives, so its adapter records refinement_status=not_supplied even though LFunctionInit itself rejected an unstable jet.
Repository-wide native and platform validation is deferred to the integration lane as coordinated; this lane ran focused CPython, Sage.js, Ruff, and direct Pyright checks.
next_steps: Expose the module through the lazy hyperelliptic public API and add bsd.py to the strict Pyright registry.
Have the model-layer adapter populate exact curve/reduction/backend provenance and convert native ball output to ArithmeticScalar interval records.
Run the lane-required architecture, strict baselib, native, WebAssembly, and cross-platform gates after shared package-budget integration.
